name: Crucible Industries Fang-9 'Switchblade'
description:
The Crucible Industries Fang-9 is a machine pistol chambered in 9x19mm with a selector switch offering semi-automatic and three-round burst fire modes. The weapon features a folding foregrip, a ported barrel to reduce muzzle climb, and an extended thirty-round magazine that protrudes well below the grip. The overall profile is aggressive and distinctly non-civilian.

The Switchblade is what happens when Crucible Industries decides to make a pistol for people who expect to be outnumbered. The three-round burst mode delivers a tight cluster at close range — approximately a four-centimeter spread at five meters — that can defeat soft body armor through sheer round concentration. The folding foregrip provides just enough control to keep bursts on target out to fifteen meters.

Crucible markets the Fang-9 exclusively to licensed security contractors and corponation enforcement arms. The reality is more complicated — the weapon's popularity on the black market rivals its legitimate sales. Its compact size, burst capability, and intimidation factor make it a favorite among organized crime enforcers who can afford the premium over conventional pistols.
legality: Restricted — contractor license required; burst mode prohibited for civilian ownership
specifications:
caliber: 9x19mm
effective_range: 35 meters (semi), 15 meters (burst)
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic / 3-round burst
magazine_capacity: 30 rounds
weight: 0.98 kg (with loaded magazine)
tactical_use: A compact select-fire weapon for close-quarters engagements where volume of fire matters. The burst mode is devastating at room-clearing distances but wastes ammunition rapidly. Best deployed in confined spaces by operators comfortable with aggressive recoil management. The extended magazine provides sustained fire capability unusual for a pistol-class weapon.
cultural_context: The Switchblade is a prestige weapon in criminal circles — owning one signals access to restricted military-grade equipment and the connections to acquire it. In legitimate security circles, it signals that your employer expects you to face threats that a standard pistol cannot handle. Either way, pulling a Fang-9 changes the temperature of any room.
story_hooks: A Fang-9 with its burst limiter removed — now capable of full automatic fire — is being used in a series of brazen daylight robberies in the Mids.
Crucible Industries hires the players to trace a pipeline of stolen Fang-9s that are appearing in Shelf gang territory at suspiciously low prices.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, aggressive machine pistol with a distinctly combat-forward stance. The silhouette is chunky and purposeful—short slide paired with a pronounced grip frame and an extended magazine that creates a top-heavy visual impression. The folded foregrip hugs the underside like a mantis limb, ready to deploy. This is a weapon designed to look dangerous.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length 185mm (210mm with foregrip extended); slide width 32mm; grip circumference 115mm; barrel length 102mm; magazine protrusion adds 65mm below grip
physical_description.weight_description: Dense and balanced despite compact dimensions. The 0.98kg loaded weight settles naturally in the palm, but the extended magazine creates a pronounced bottom-heavy feel that demands two-handed control. Not light—purposefully substantial.
physical_description.primary_material: Steel slide with polymer lower receiver; ported barrel is treated steel; aluminum magazine body with witness holes
physical_description.finish: Matte black DLC-coated slide with brushed unpainted aluminum accents on the fire selector and charging handle. Polymer grip shows subtle grip stippling. Magazine body has a flat, utilitarian finish with no gloss.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal black primary; muted aluminum gray on controls and porting; safety selector ring in electric blue anodize (manufacturer signature)
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressive cross-hatched stippling on front and backstrap; rubberized grip panels insert in the lower receiver with aggressive bite. Foregrip when deployed is wrapped in rough-texture cord for positive purchase under stress.
distinctive_features: Ported barrel with four radial ports visible along top surface, designed to bleed gas and reduce climb
Folding foregrip mechanism with positive detent clicks when extended or folded flush
Fire selector ring in electric blue anodize with clear Semi/Burst/Safe markings
Extended 30-round magazine with witness holes at 10/20/30-round intervals
Charging handle canted slightly forward for thumb-operated manipulation
Decocker lever positioned above trigger guard
Accessory rail segment on slide (front post position) for secondary optics mounting
Maker's mark: 'CRUCIBLE INDUSTRIES FANG-9' laser-etched on slide in squared sans-serif font
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Crucible Industries logo (geometric angular design) stamped on left side of slide; 'FANG-9' in bold capitals below; contract license ID engraving required on right side frame; serial number on frame behind trigger guard
physical_description.condition_typical: Varies sharply by deployment context. Legitimate contractor weapons maintain pristine finishes with minimal wear. Black market variants show heavy use: worn bluing on slide edges, scratched stippling, carbon buildup around porting, trigger-guard scuffs from holster draw cycles. Some field units feature custom grip tape additions or improvised sling attachments.
